_why: F13#5 function (ACCEPTANCE §6.1 F13; ART_DIRECTION Tidewake: 'Docks read as lived destinations'). A code-blind round-1 read (ralph/reports/TIDEWAKE/phase1/f13_5/r1) found six of seven mandatory docks with no people. This presentation-only layer (scripts/world/water_dock_residents.gd) stands two dock hands from the installed humanoid cast at every mandatory departure dock, on land beside the dock dressing's cargo cluster and off the safe->shore swim lane. They are not named characters, have no prompt, no dialogue, no collider (a route walker or swimmer cannot snag on them) and no state; every peer builds the same people from this file. The profiles are installed art.json bodies that no Tidewake named NPC wears, so a resident is never mistaken for a quest giver.
_why_profiles: Rotated by dock index so neighbouring docks show different people.

at the head of the dock, looking out over the crossing
